title: Morgan and Townsend Brown's conversation about a time travel list

tellings.quote: Well, that recalls a conversation between Morgan and Townsend Brown, where Morgan's in his office and Townsend Brown said, "What if What if we had the ability to time travel? You know, I believe we're going to be able to do it in our lifetime."

plain: In a man named Morgan's office, the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown, whom Michels calls a scientist who worked with the CIA, the US spy agency, once asked: "What if we had the ability to time travel?" He added that he believed it would happen in their lifetime. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as a sign of how far Brown's thinking reached.
